newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telerj posts 94.2 mln-real Jan-Aug net.
newsitem.headline: Telerj posts 94.2 mln-real Jan-Aug net.

text.p: Brazilian state telecoms firms Telerj and Telepar posted net profits of 94.238 million reais and 90.809 million reais respectively in the first eight months, an official said.
The firms are subsidiaries of federally-owned Telebras. Telerj serves Rio de Janeiro state and Telepar operates in Parana state.

A Telebras spokesman also said Telebrasilia, which serves the federal district, posted earnings of 66.78 million reais and Telebahia in the northern state of Bahia reported a 57.57 million-real net profit, he added.
Details on the four firms' eight-month financial reports as well as comparative figures for the January-August period last year were not immediately available.
On Tuesday, Telebras reported an eight-month consolidated net profit of 1.803 billion reais and earnings of 2.1 billion reais for its holding.
The Telebras system, with its 28 subsidiaries, are slated to be privatized starting next year.
